source.test: applyTransferImport(...) — live world folders present alongside world_slots/

expected.reasoning: level-name is read from the just-copied destURL/server.properties (source line 470-473, defaulting to "world" if blank), giving candidates [levelName, levelName_nether, levelName_the_end]. Each that exists in the package is copied and sets restoredLiveWorld = true (line 465-484). The `if !restoredLiveWorld` guard at line 497 then short-circuits, so WorldSlotManager.activeSlot(forServerDir:)/activateSlot is never called even though world_slots/active_slot_id.txt names slot-a as active -- live folders always take precedence over the slot marker when both are present.

notes: TransferManifest carries no field that says 'prefer live worlds' or 'prefer the active slot' -- the choice is made purely by testing which folders exist in the already-copied destination directory (source lines 469-497), not by anything recorded in manifest.json at export time. This fixture and older-package-no-live-worlds.json exercise the two branches of that same `if`; read them together, not in isolation.
